channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Fidan, Kalın host top Ukrainian negotiator to discuss peace efforts
item.description: Ukraine’s National Security and Defense Council Secretary Rustem Umerov met separately in Ankara with Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and National Intelligence Organization (MIT) chief Ibrahim Kalın, as diplomatic activity intensifies around efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: Türkiye to host world-renowned musicians in 2026
item.description: From global rock and metal icons to alternative and experimental acts, internationally acclaimed artists will perform in Istanbul and other major cities across Türkiye in 2026

item.title: Antalya tops 17 million tourists, marks another record year
item.description: Türkiye’s leading holiday destination Antalya ended 2025 with a new visitor record, welcoming a total of 17.12 million tourists, according to Culture and Tourism Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy.

item.title: Türkiye braces for avalanche risk as deep freeze hits
item.description: Türkiye is facing a prolonged spell of extreme winter weather, with freezing temperatures, strong winds and a heightened avalanche risk persisting into the first days of the new year, according to the country’s weather bureau.

item.title: Libya says UK to analyse black box from crash that killed general
item.description: Libya said on Thursday that Britain had agreed to analyse the black box from a plane crash in Türkiye on Dec. 23 that killed a Libyan military delegation, including the head of its army.

item.title: Small Turkish city under spotlight amid ISIL cell probe
item.description: The family of one of the ISIL terrorists killed in a recent clash in the northwestern province of Yalova has refused to receive his body, as authorities continue to investigate why the group chose the small city as a base of operations.

item.title: Identifying Swiss fire victims may take weeks, say officials
item.description: Investigators raced on Jan. 2 to identify the victims of a fire that ripped through a bar in the Swiss Alps town of Crans-Montana, turning a New Year's celebration into one of the country's worst tragedies.

item.title: Türkiye enters 2026 focused on disinflation and sustainable growth
item.description: Türkiye is heading into 2026 with inflation, exports and the next steps in its disinflation drive at the top of the economic agenda, alongside efforts to keep growth steady and broad-based.

item.title: Iran cost-of-living protests rage on as Trump, Tehran trade barbs
item.description: The widening demonstrations over Iran’s ailing economy entered their sixth day on Jan. 2, spreading into the country’s rural provinces, with U.S. President Donald Trump and senior Iranian officials trading barbs over the unrest.

item.title: Erdoğan says to talk Ukraine, Gaza with Trump over phone
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has said that he will hold a telephone call with U.S. President Donald Trump on Jan. 5 to address the war in Ukraine and the Gaza crisis.
